name: bootstrap
summary: start a new Talos cluster on booted machines and wait until every node is ready, without the operator

flags.name: apply-insecure
flags.usage: deliver configs over the UNAUTHENTICATED maintenance API: container/dev tiers only; on metal the config rides the BMC media channel

flags.name: endpoint
flags.usage: address of --node (default: its spec.address or first static address)

flags.name: image-factory
flags.usage: image factory host the installer image is named on

flags.name: node
flags.usage: drive only this TalosNode (default: every node in --dir)

flags.name: secrets
flags.usage: secrets bundle from talosctl gen secrets, or - for stdin (required)

flags.name: timeout
flags.usage: overall deadline: apply, bootstrap retries, readiness
